rationale: O'Kelly et al. define accident probability under a base distribution of standard traffic behavior and identify estimating that distribution as essential. The claim preserves simulator, distribution, and threshold conditionality and rejects the move from accumulated miles to unconditional safety.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-003-R1, O'Kelly et al., Scalable End-to-End Autonomous Vehicle Testing via Rare-event Simulation, PDF p. 1
S-EVID-003-R2, O'Kelly et al., PDF p. 2
limitations: This is a highway research case study using importance sampling, not a regulatory method or airborne DAA validation.
The package does not validate scenario generation, tail assumptions, rendering fidelity, threshold selection, or estimator behavior under shift.
